Develop and fine-tune AI models (including LLMs) for financial applications, such as compliance automation, transaction monitoring, and chatbot development

Participate in AI-driven projects such as workflow automation, AI-enabled research, and data analysis using Python and machine learning frameworks 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, compliance) to design and implement AI solutions 
Conduct market research and data analysis to identify trends and AI opportunities in the digital payment industry 
Support business and operations teams to drive user adoption of our digital products

Requirements 

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree program in Business Administration, AI, IT, Design, Fintech, Multimedia, or related field

Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, Web3, and the digital payments industry 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills 
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is required, proficiency in English and Cantonese 
A proactive and detail-oriented approach

title: Robotics Navigation & Embodied AI Engineer
jd_raw:
关于我们

AIdea Technologies Limited 2024 年于香港成立，由香港中文大学顶尖教授与资深科研团队创立，依托近 20 年多模态感知与边缘智能技术深耕，是一家专注多模态感知 × Edge AI × 具身智能的前沿科技企业。

我们以隐私优先、场景落地为核心，将多模态 AI、LLM/VLM 大模型深度融入家庭、康养与商业空间，打造无感、安全、智能的下一代健康守护体验。公司核心产品包括隐私保护热成像监测、家庭健康助手、早期临床诊断系统等，精准解决行业隐私焦虑、佩戴率低、预警滞后等核心痛点，覆盖康养机构、社区与家庭全场景。

面向未来，我们正式迈入家庭康养机器人新纪元—— 在原有无感监测能力之上，打造可自主导航、精准感知、自然交互、主动关怀的家用康养守护机器人，让 AI 从 “被动监测” 走向 “主动陪伴”，构建从安全预警、健康管理到主动服务的全链路智能康养生态。

我们希望找到一位既能扎实落地底层导航与 SLAM，又对具身智能（VLN / Agentic Robot）有热情的工程师，和我们一起把机器人从原型推进到真实产品。

你将参与

底盘自主与运动控制：负责移动机器人底盘的自主导航、路径规划、避障与运动控制。

定位与建图（SLAM）：基于激光 / 视觉 SLAM 实现环境建图、实时定位与重定位，处理动态环境下的鲁棒性问题。

人体感知与跟随：开发行人跟踪、人体姿态识别与人物跟随能力，支撑机器人在有人环境中的安全交互。

具身智能与 Agent 系统：参与视觉语言导航（VLN）与 Agentic Robot 系统开发，重点建设 Agent 的 空间记忆 能力，让机器人能够理解、记忆并复用环境与任务信息。

系统集成与工程验证：在 ROS / ROS2 框架下完成各模块集成、调试与测试评估，快速验证技术方案并参与产品迭代。

关于你

基础要求：

硕士学位（计算机 / 电子 / 自动化 / 机器人 / AI 相关方向），或本科 + 1–2 年相关全职经验。

具备移动机器人 底盘自主导航与运动控制 的项目经验（路径规划、避障、控制等）。

熟悉 激光 / 视觉 SLAM，有建图与定位相关的工程实践。

有 行人跟踪 / 人体姿态识别 相关的开发或落地经验。

对 VLN、Agentic Robot 系统 有了解或实践，尤其是 Agent 空间记忆 方向的开发经验（强加分，优秀者可优先考虑）。

熟悉 ROS / ROS2 下的开发流程与常用工具链。

熟练 C / C++ 与 Python，熟悉 Linux 开发环境；有 PyTorch 或相关深度学习框架使用经验。

动手能力强：能独立推进方案验证、问题定位和工程实现。

能够阅读英文技术文档，进行基本的中英文沟通。

加分项：

熟悉常见导航 / SLAM 框架与工具（如 Nav2、move_base、Cartographer、ORB-SLAM、LIO/LVIO、gmapping 等）。

有 LiDAR / 深度相机 / IMU / ToF 等传感器的标定与多传感器融合经验。

有真机调试与硬件联调经验，熟悉机器人底盘、电机驱动、嵌入式控制等。

有 机械臂相关项目 的开发经验（如运动学 / 抓取规划、MoveIt、力控、视觉伺服等）。

有 VLM / LLM 在机器人任务规划、指令理解或 Agent 工作流中的落地经验。

有模型部署 / 端侧推理经验（如推理服务、量化 / 蒸馏、INT8/INT4 等）。

有 Gazebo / Isaac Sim / MuJoCo 等仿真平台使用经验。

在医疗 / 养老 / 服务机器人 / IoT 赛道有实际产品落地经验。

有开源项目、机器人比赛、硬件 hackathon 等可展示作品。

能用 Cursor / Claude Code / Codex 等 AI 编程工具显著放大自己的工程产出。

你将获得

有竞争力的薪酬，长期香港工作签证，并视贡献提供长期激励。

完整的项目参与度：从硬件选型、算法设计到产品优化全流程参与，直接参与真实机器人产品的持续迭代。

资深团队：与多模态感知、AI、机器人与硬件工程方向的资深技术专家与工程团队共事。

本岗位主要招聘全职。

必备能力

1. 熟练使用 Python，掌握数据预处理与特征工程。

JETCO also offers a series of value-added services to member banks, such as payment gateway for e-Commerce and inter-bank cardless cash withdrawal service, to enable member banks to provide customers with innovative and high-quality services.

In 2018, The Hong Kong Monetary Authority designated the relevant payment systems operated by JETCO for the processing of Hong Kong retail payment transactions as a designated retail payment system (“designated RPS”) pursuant to the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (“PSSVFO”).

In 2019, JETCO launched JETCO APIX, the first open API exchange platform in Hong Kong.  By riding on JETCO APIX, banks and other institution customers can interconnect with their business partners in various industries via API to co-develop innovative products and services for improving service quality and customer experience.

In 2022, JETCO CDI Portal for data consumers launched for supporting banks to easily onboard to Commercial Data Interchange (“CDI”), and JETCO has been named as a solution provider of CDI.  In 2023, JETCO CDI Portal has extended to support data providers to onboard to CDI.  Moreover, JETCO CDI APIs & value-added features for data consumers were launched.  Coming will have more value-added features launching for both data consumers and data providers.

In July 2024, JETCO IADS Proxy Service launched for supporting banks to participate HKMA’s Interbank Account Data Sharing (“IADS”) programme as the data consuming bank to retrieve their customers’ bank account data from other banks subject to customer consents.

In October 2024, JETCO has joined as the participant in Project Ensemble and has connected to Ensemble Sandbox, as well as completed PoC by partnering with banks to testify Payment-versus-Payment (“PvP”) and Delivery-versus-Payment (“DvP”) scenarios. In November 2025, we became one of the participants of EnsembleTX and partnered with banks to test different use cases of interbank settlement using tokenised deposit (“TD”) by riding on our distributed ledger technology (“DLT”) TD platform.

title: Embedded Systems Architect
jd_raw:
About KickAss

KickAss is a leading Australian outdoor adventure brand. We design and make portable electrical equipment that lets people live and travel off-grid — away from mains power.
 
Our products include batteries, solar panels, battery chargers, power inverters, and monitoring screens, used by customers who go four-wheel-driving, caravanning, and camping.

We are an Australian-owned company. Our team works across both Australia and China, and includes Western and Chinese members. This role is based in our office in Tangxia, Dongguan. Learn more at www.kickassproducts.com.au

About the role

We are looking for an Embedded Systems Architect to design the technology that connects all of our electronic products together.

Today, each product (a battery, a charger, an inverter, and so on) works on its own. Our goal is to make them work as one connected system that a customer can monitor and control from a single mobile app and a single display screen. We call this our "one app, one screen, one ecosystem" vision.

You will be the senior technical leader for this platform. You decide the overall design and the technology we use to build it. This is not a project-management role, and it is not a role designing one single product. Our product owner decides what we build for customers; you decide how it is built and make sure every product fits one well-designed system.

You will report to senior leadership and work daily with our teams in Australia and China, our suppliers, and the engineers who will report to you.

What you will do

Design the overall platform — decide how the devices, screens, apps, and online (cloud) services work together as one system
Choose the core technology, including the operating system the products run on (for example, embedded Linux such as Yocto, or a real-time operating system / RTOS)
Design how the different parts of the system send information to each other, using one shared, consistent data format
Connect products that "speak" different technical languages (communication protocols such as RS485, CAN, BLE/Bluetooth and Modbus) and translate them into that one shared format
Set the technical standards, rules, and documents that our engineers and suppliers must follow
Decide how the team uses AI tools to build software faster, while keeping quality safe and controlled
Document the system clearly using simple technical diagrams so others can build from your design
Review the software and designs supplied by outside partners, and reduce our reliance on closed "black-box" solutions we cannot control
Help build and lead the engineering team, including hiring the firmware and hardware engineers who report to you
What you need

Fluent English and Mandarin, spoken and written
Strong experience designing embedded systems and connected ("smart") electronic products
Experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto, Buildroot, or Ubuntu Core, firmware and device drivers
Communication interfaces such as UART, RS485, CAN, BLE, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Modbus
Experience designing how separate apps, services, and devices communicate (NATS, MQTT, ZeroMQ, D-Bus, gRPC or DDS)
Able to design a system first, then write clear, simple documents that engineers can build from
Confident working with suppliers and reviewing their technical work
Comfortable leading engineers who use AI tools in their work
Why join us

This is a high-impact role with real ownership. You will design the technical foundation that every future KickAss connected product is built on, and you will be the key technical link between our Australia and China teams and our suppliers.

The role is based in our Dongguan office, with regular visits to suppliers within China and occasional travel.

title: Product Manager (Collectibles)
jd_raw:
Best fit for someone who likes shipping prototypes early, talking to users without prompting, and being measured on whether the thing actually worked — not just whether it shipped.

Responsibilities:

Collectibles features end-to-end. 1–6 month delivery cycles with 3–8 engineers. You'll write specs with concrete "Done means" observables (Jira keys, release versions, named surfaces) — not vague intent.

Run growth experiments. Design and analyze A/B tests across discovery, signup, first-purchase funnel, and repeat-purchase loops. Defend success metrics with rigor — pre-register the win condition, read the result honestly.

Understand the collector. TCG buyers behave nothing like generic e-commerce shoppers — they research scarcity, follow set releases, and compare auction prices across markets. You'll talk to them directly via interview rounds, surveys, and analytical studies. BNS has no UXR function — PMs own user research end-to-end.

Self-serve data. Use Claude Code + BNS BQ MCP to query our analytics warehouse for retention, funnel, and cohort questions without queueing requests. Read A/B test results. Write 10-row eval sets for any AI feature you touch.

Prototype to derisk. Build clickable demos with Claude Design / Claude Code / Figma Make before scoping non-trivial engineering work. Test with real collectors when stakes warrant — invest engineering time more wisely.

Honest delivery. Calibrate your dev-done commitments with Confidence H/M/L, escalate dependency risks early, and own PM-side slip causes when they happen (vague spec, missing decision, late descope, didn't escalate).

Requirements:

0–4 years of product management experience (T1: 0–2; T2: 1–4), or related roles where you've owned outcomes end-to-end.

Comfortable running growth experiments / A/B tests — designing them, defending success metrics, and reading the results honestly.

Data-driven: funnel analysis, cohort/retention reading, and experiment design exposure.

Proficient in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English — collectors, suppliers, and our team move across all three.

AI tooling proficiency. A baseline expectation, not a bonus — you already use AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma Make, NL-to-SQL assistants, or equivalent) to prototype ideas, query data, and accelerate your own work. This bar is deliberately set above the Google/Meta APM baseline because it's how we ship at our team's size.

Direct, specific communication. You name specific blockers in asks rather than vague needs, and you'd rather make an evidence-anchored claim than a polished one.

Nice to have:

Background in growth product work (acquisition, activation, retention, monetization) or interest in being evaluated partly on metrics moved.

Domain interest in collectibles, TCG, Pokemon cards, gaming communities, or marketplace/auction-style products — you'll be deep in this culture daily, and genuine fans get further faster.

Working with engineering teams of 3–8 on technical initiatives.



The Opportunity for Talent:

You'll start as a PM on the Collectibles vertical. Growth happens via scope expansion (feature → workstream → vertical) and judgment-quality maturity (Confidence calibration, descope decisions, proactive unblocking). Strong performance opens a path to lead PM on this or an adjacent vertical.

本科或以上學歷，主修商業、金融、法律、資訊科技、風險管理等相關專業；

title: Web3 and Ecosystem Manager

About Finoverse 

Finoverse is the largest global tech network, specialising in bringing people and experiences together that lead to transformative change.  


Since 2015, Finoverse has spearheaded world-class experiential FinTech and Web3 events, celebrated the voices of the next generation, and created a collaborative space valued by over 202,000 senior executives, founders, investors, and family offices from more than 130 countries,  across Asia, the Middle East, and North America.  


In 2025 the company launched Finoverse AI, the team behind Samantha, the AI community host that conducts assessments and in-depth interviews on WhatsApp at scale. Finoverse has offices in Hong Kong and Shenzhen.


With offices in Hong Kong, Shenzhen and Dubai, Finoverse sparks conversations and connects professionals -  from regulators to entrepreneurs, from big banks to start-ups, from technology to traditional finance.




Why Join Us

Finoverse sits at a unique crossroads where generational wealth holders seek innovation and where builders seek strategic capital. Our team operates in an energetic, globally minded culture with daily exposure to top business leaders, family office principals, regulators, and pioneering founders. We want people who thrive at this intersection, bringing bold ideas, entrepreneurial energy, and a passion for shaping the future of finance and wealth.


Making a Positive Impact is in Our DNA
We innovate in what we do and who we are as individuals. Finoverse empowers and unites those who share the same core values as us to make positive contributions and instil transformative changes in our network and community.


Your role at Finoverse

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies and promotional materials (Web3-focused).

Create, curate, and manage engaging content across various channels, including social media and EDM.

Build and nurture relationships with Web3 communities, influencers, and industry partners.

Identify, establish and nurture strategic partnerships with key stakeholders and organizations within the Web3 community.

Analyze marketing performance metrics and generate reports to optimize future campaigns.

Stay updated on industry trends, competitors, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, and other Web3 developments to ensure content relevance.

Responsible for planning and hosting various events, including conferences, VIP gatherings, global seminars, and business networking receptions (Web3-focused).

Collaborate with stakeholders to define the agenda that meets the event's goals.

Research and identify potential speakers who align with the event’s theme.

Drive innovation in marketing approaches tailored for the decentralized Web3 ecosystem.






Who you are

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism / Public Relations, or related field

At least 5+ years of experience in digital marketing and content management within the Web3, blockchain, or cryptocurrency sectors.

Strong understanding of blockchain technology, DeFi, NFTs, and the broader Web3 ecosystem.

Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills.

Experience with community engagement and building relationships with industry influencers.

Creative thinking and the ability to develop innovative content ideas.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Capable of working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a proactive approach.

Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, previous experience working in startups or small teams would be a plus

Proficient in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin



Abilities we are looking for

Creative mindset and ability to implement an effective marketing strategy

Outstanding communication and coordination skills, with the confidence to engage new speakers and VIPs

A confident and approachable individual who prioritizes the experiences of VIPs and speakers

Strong analytical abilities

Detail-oriented with excellent time management skills, capable of handling multiple tasks effectively

Eager to learn and open to taking on new challenges

A collaborative team player who can also work independently

Ability to thrive under pressure and a commitment to exceeding expectations

Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment
